def solve(I):
    from collections import Counter
    cc=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    dom=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[k for k in cc if k!=dom]
    src=others[0] if len(others)==1 else None
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(1,W-1):
            if I[r][c]==dom and I[r][c-1]==src and I[r][c+1]==src:
                O[r][c]=2
    return O
print(solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
